question: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to LEARNED.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Ignorant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Learned"** means someone who is highly educated or knowledgeable, often gained through study or experience. (पढ़ा-लिखा, विद्वान)

 
 
• **Example:** The professor is learned in ancient history and cultural studies.
 
 
 
• **"Ignorant"** refers to someone who lacks knowledge, education, or awareness about something. (अज्ञानी)
 
 
• **Example:** He remained ignorant of the changes happening around him due to his lack of interest in current affairs.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Learned'** is **'Ignorant'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Ignorant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Informed** (जानकारी होना): Having or showing knowledge about a particular subject or situation.

 
 
• **Example:** She is well-informed about the latest advancements in technology.
 
 
 
• **Expert** (विशेषज्ञ): A person who has a comprehensive and authoritative knowledge or skill in a particular area.
 
 
• **Example:** He is an expert in artificial intelligence and machine learning.
 
 
 
• **Educated** (शिक्षित): Someone who has received a good education and is knowledgeable.
 
 
• **Example:** She comes from a highly educated family.
